'''Revised Hoth''' is the 16th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in October 1998.<ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hoth_Revised_Unlimited Hoth Revised Unlimited] at Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220929171043/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hoth_Revised_Unlimited Internet Archive]</ref> It is the white-border Revised Unlimited reprint of [[Hoth Limited]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

It reprints the 162-card Limited pool with Special Edition–era revised text. The card list is below.

== Packaging ==
It was sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 30-pack boxes. Each box included a fold-out Rules Supplement.<ref name="encyc" />
